configuration.scope: Conditional examples at 1 K intrinsic polarization RMS at 30 MHz, with assumed local columns and angular statistics. Linear and PCHIP native-beam interpolants define a model comparison, not a measured fine-channel response. Gaussian visibility illustrations retain the complex relation and both sidereal phases. No detection significance is inferred.

scope: Q and U RMS are reported separately, with power transmission distinct from amplitude ratios. All local profiles, screens, Gaussian/scale-mixture moments, bands, phases and channel types use the same smooth fit and time average. Voltage/current noise and lunar temperatures remain assumed scenarios. Native-beam interpolants and ablations give model spread, not a calibrated uncertainty or detection significance. Fixed sky repeats only reduce independent measurement noise.
